content_summary: A four-product cooking-efficiency listicle driven by ultra-fast action inserts, numbered segment markers and food-result proof.
reusable_editing_rules: A numbered list hook can establish authority and scope in under 2s if several result shots are compressed into the opening montage.
Persistent 1/4-4/4 navigation makes very fast product switching easier to follow.
For appliance Shorts, alternate input/action/result frames at sub-second cadence, then use a human eating shot as proof/payoff.
